decision.rationale: Discard from advancement: audited seed-42 development mean HR@10 was 0.59075 for the candidate, 0.59225 for the matched seventh-block control, and 0.59525 for the incumbent. Neither new arm exceeded the incumbent, and host eligibility for confirmation is false. The candidate-control difference was -0.0015 overall, with positive and negative category contrasts. This selection result does not establish whether shallow features were preserved or useful.
unresolved_explanations: The final encoder may already retain useful shallow features; the added paths may affect capacity or optimization; L2 normalization does not equalize the tapped state distributions; and single-seed initialization or checkpoint selection may contribute to the mixed effects.

Host admission and synthetic pre- and post-training probes do not report the proposed fixed-state, nonzero-weight branch intervention, zero-initialization equivalence to the incumbent, or forward and scoring identities after a synthetic update. All-input semantics and causal isolation remain unproved.

History-length results are exploratory dependent slices, include negative and null effects, and lack a matched control-by-history contrast. Sparse long-history bins cannot support a history-specific mechanism claim. No confirmation or final-test evidence was supplied.
